date_note: Date of PLUS's announcement as reported by Cybersecurity.com (Japan) on 19 Nov; PLUS's own notice was not found.
title: PLUS says information of four services, incl. JOINTEX, may have leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
summary: According to Cybersecurity.com (Japan), PLUS announced on 18 November that information of four services (JOINTEX, smartoffice, smartschool, smart care) may have leaked through unauthorized access to PLAID's KARTE. It gives a cumulative total of 32,479 items, which it says is not a count of people, mostly login IDs and email addresses. No secondary harm was confirmed at announcement. PLUS has suspended KARTE use and plans individual notices.
plain: PLUS says data from four of its services may have leaked in the KARTE breach at PLAID: 32,479 items in total, which is not a count of people.
exec: Another KARTE customer reports possible leaks, 32,479 items in total; PLAID's breach keeps spreading to its customers.
action: Users of JOINTEX, smartoffice, smartschool and smart care should be alert to phishing at the email addresses involved; PLUS says it will notify those affected individually.

sources.name: PLAID notice, 16 Nov 2026 (leak of information possibly including personal data)

validation.note: PLUS's own announcement was not found. Cybersecurity.com (Japan) relays it; PLAID's 16 Nov notice confirms the KARTE breach but does not mention PLUS.

links.rel: customer data leaked via breached KARTE service
